name: searchle-mobile
description: Searchle Mobile — Three.js stream overlay with 3D visuals

scripts.build: npx vite build --config vite.config.js && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('client/v', 'dist/v', {recursive:true, force:true})"
scripts.build:ptbr: node tools/ptbr-model-lab.js build fasttext-cc-pt && node tools/ptbr-model-lab.js build numberbatch-pt && node tools/ptbr-model-lab.js build nilc-glove-300d
scripts.gate:ptbr: node tools/ptbr-word-gate.js build fasttext-cc-pt --output=fasttext-cc-pt-gated --max-words=180000 --min-zipf=2.5 && node tools/ptbr-word-gate.js build numberbatch-pt --output=numberbatch-pt-gated --max-words=180000 --min-zipf=2.5 && node tools/ptbr-word-gate.js build nilc-glove-300d --output=nilc-glove-300d-gated --max-words=180000 --min-zipf=2.5
scripts.download:all: npm run download:glove && npm run download:fasttext && npm run download:word2vec
